attchmntText: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication Under Regulation 47 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 regarding Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026
sm_name: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited
voiceSummary: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 13, 2026, regarding its un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee on November 12, 2026, and approved by the Board on the same date. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net loss of 12.42 lakhs, compared to a net loss of 10.83 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net loss was 33.66 lakhs, compared to a loss of 18.75 lakhs in the previous half year. Diluted earnings per share for the quarter were negative 0.07, compared to negative 0.06 in the prior year. The company has no subsidiary or associate companies.

attchmntText: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited has informed the Exchange about the Appointment of Secretarial Auditors of the Company
sm_name: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited
voiceSummary: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited appointed M/s. HB and Associates as its new Secretarial Auditor with immediate effect from November 12, 2026. This appointment fills a casual vacancy caused by the resignation of the previous auditor, M/s. JMACS Associates, on November 4, 2026. The Board approved the appointment during its meeting on November 12, 2026. M/s. HB and Associates will serve for five consecutive financial years, from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31. Their tenure continues until the conclusion of the 86th Annual General Meeting in 2031. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval at the ensuing Annual General Meeting. The firm is based in Trivandrum and has over twenty years of experience.

attchmntText: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited financial results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited
voiceSummary: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss of 12.42 lakhs for the quarter and 10.83 lakhs for the half year. Basic and diluted earnings per share were negative 0.08 for the quarter and negative 0.18 for the half year. The board noted the resignation of M/s JMACS Associates as Secretarial Auditor effective November 4, 2026. The board approved the appointment of M/s HB and Associates as the new Secretarial Auditor for a five-year tenure from 2026-27 to 2030-31. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval at the next Annual General Meeting in 2031.
